basic_details.job_title: IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow (Mechanical Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Jammu is recruiting one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) for the research project "Design And Analysis Of Nuclear Coupled Thermal-Hydraulic Behaviour Of Liquid Metal Cooled Bharat Micro Modular Reactor" (project code RP-100385), sanctioned by Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF). The consolidated pay is INR 37,000 a month plus 20% HRA (as applicable) for up to one year, with a minimum of 60% marks (or 6.5/10.0 CGPA) in the engineering degree. Only Indian nationals can apply, by uploading the application with scanned documents on https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian nationals. The essential qualification and shortlisting criteria for JRF are one of the following: M.Tech./M.E. in Mechanical/Chemical/Computer Science & Engineering and B.Tech./B.E. in Mechanical/Chemical/Computer Science & Engineering, with a minimum of 60% marks (or 6.5/10.0 CGPA); OR B.Tech./B.E. degree in Mechanical/Chemical/Computer Science & Engineering and related streams, with a minimum of 60% marks (or 6.5/10.0 CGPA) throughout, starting from Class XII. Sound knowledge of programming languages like C/C++, Python, FORTRAN Experience in working on CFD software e.g. Ansys etc. Sound knowledge of physics informed AI/ML The upper age limit is 50 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age. Relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST/women/physically challenged candidates and 3 years for OBC NCL. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility for the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay depends on whether the candidate holds a national-level qualification: The position runs for up to one year only or earlier, as required for the project. The notice states the HRA as "as applicable".

rows.candidate: Valid GATE/NET score or other prescribed national-level qualifying examination, or admitted to the M.Tech./M.E. programme through GATE qualification (S. No. 3, Clause (i) of ANRF Office Memorandum No. ANRF/OM/N-01/2024 dated 14.10.2024)

Eligible candidates without GATE/NET or any other prescribed national-level qualifying examination, including M.Tech./M.E. degree holders who have never qualified GATE (S. No. 3, Clause (ii) of the said Office Memorandum)
rows.remuneration: ₹30,000/- per month plus HRA @ 20% as Project Associate-I, or as per the applicable remuneration based on experience, as prescribed under the said Office Memorandum

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Open the online portal https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/#/home . Upload the duly filled application form along with scanned certificates and documents by 9 December 2026. Upload all documents on educational qualification (10, 12, graduation, post-graduation etc.) and on experience. Give a valid e-mail ID and phone number in the application, because shortlisted candidates are informed of the interview by e-mail. For correspondence, the notice gives Prof. Goutam Dutta, Department of Mechanical Engineering, IIT Jammu, e-mail [email protected] , phone +91 191 257 1239, mobile +91 82692 33355. The institute's letterhead e-mail is [email protected] . Duly filled application form with scanned certificates and documents Documents on educational qualification (10, 12, graduation, post-graduation etc.) and experience At the interview: an updated CV and original and attested photocopies of mark sheets/certificates supporting academic qualifications A relieving certificate from the employer, for candidates already employed, if selected

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates may be shortlisted based on merit and need for the project. Merely possessing the prescribed qualification does not ensure a call for the interview. Only shortlisted candidates are called, and the date and time are informed by e-mail. The interview will be held using the online/offline platform. Shortlisted candidates must appear on the interview date with the documents listed above.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: The interview date will be informed to shortlisted candidates by e-mail.

Candidates already employed should produce a relieving certificate from their employers if selected. faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow vacancies has IIT Jammu announced?
faq.answer: IIT Jammu has announced 1 (one) Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position for the ANRF-sanctioned project RP-100385.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving the duly filled-in application is 9 December 2026, through the online portal https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/#/home.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Jammu JRF post?
faq.answer: Either M.Tech./M.E. and B.Tech./B.E. in Mechanical/Chemical/Computer Science & Engineering with minimum 60% marks (or 6.5/10.0 CGPA), or B.Tech./B.E. in these and related streams with minimum 60% marks (or 6.5/10.0 CGPA) throughout from Class XII.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT Jammu JRF post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 50 years, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST/women/physically challenged candidates and 3 years for OBC NCL.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIT Jammu JRF?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is INR 37,000 per month plus 20% HRA (as applicable) for candidates with valid GATE/NET or another prescribed national-level qualifying examination. Candidates without it are considered at ₹30,000 per month plus HRA @ 20% as Project Associate-I, or as per applicable remuneration based on experience.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the IIT Jammu JRF post?
faq.answer: Upload the duly filled application form with scanned certificates and documents on https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/#/home by 9 December 2026, with a valid e-mail ID and phone number.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for the IIT Jammu JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates may be shortlisted based on merit and need for the project, and shortlisted candidates are called for an interview on an online/offline platform. The interview date is informed by e-mail.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the IIT Jammu JRF position?
faq.answer: The position is for up to one year only or earlier, as required for the project.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA paid for the IIT Jammu JRF interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says candidates should reach IIT Jammu on their own fund, and TA/DA is not permissible for the offline interview or for joining the position if the job is offered.

faq.question: Q10. Can IIT Jammu JRF candidates be admitted to the Ph.D. programme?
faq.answer: A candidate who meets IIT Jammu's eligibility criteria, applies for the Ph.D. program and is recommended by the selection committee may be admitted to the program now or in the future.
